name: Citroën flat-twin type A 79/1 (plate AYA 2), 435 cc (24 ch DIN / 26 ch SAE at 6750 rpm), 2CV 4 1970-1979
summary: A short-stroke development of the 425 (68.5 x 59 mm, 8.5:1) that makes its power at 6750 rpm, the highest-revving 2CV engine; fed by one Solex 34 PICS and exhausting through heat exchangers into a crossbox under the gearbox and on to a rear silencer.

cylinders.note: 'deux cylindres à plat ou flat-twin de type boxer' (two cylinders flat, a boxer flat-twin).

layout.note: Boxer flat-twin, air-cooled, aluminium crankcase, finned cast-iron cylinders: 'bloc-moteur en alliage d'aluminium, cylindres en fonte munis d'ailettes de refroidissement, refroidi par air forcé'.

crank.value: two crank throws at 180 degrees; both pistons reach top dead centre together and move in and out together (boxer); two main bearings; crankshaft built up of five pressed steel pieces with the connecting rods captive
crank.note: 'doté d'un vilebrequin à deux paliers'; 'Le vilebrequin est constitué de cinq pièces en acier frettées incluant les bielles ... l'embiellage est indémontable' (the crankshaft is five shrink-fitted steel pieces including the rods; the rod assembly cannot be taken apart). That both pistons are at TDC at once is from the ignition section: at each spark 'un cylindre étant alors au point mort haut de compression ... l'autre en opposition de phase, tombant en fin d'échappement' (one cylinder at TDC on compression, the other at the end of its exhaust stroke). That the pistons move toward and away from each other together: Méhari Club Cassis on the breather, 'lorsque les pistons reviennent l'un vers l'autre ... lorsque ces mêmes pistons s'éloignent' (https://infos-club.mehariclub.com/?p=3949). Rods on needle bearings, crankshaft supplied with its two rods: kfz-tech.de (https://www.kfz-tech.de/Engl/Hersteller/Citroen/Citroen2CVM.htm).

firing_order.note: Two cylinders firing alternately; the article names no cylinder numbering.

firing_intervals_deg.note: Even: each cylinder fires once per two turns and the two reach firing TDC one turn apart, from the crank description above. Ignition is wasted spark: 'une étincelle est commandée à chaque tour du vilebrequin dans les deux chambres de combustion' (a spark in both chambers every crankshaft revolution), from one breaker worked by a two-lobed cam on the camshaft nose and a coil with two high-tension outputs ('une came à deux bossages en bout de l'arbre à cames ... La bobine à deux sorties haute tension').

valvetrain.value: two valves per cylinder in a V in hemispherical aluminium heads; one central camshaft below the crankshaft, gear-driven with an anti-backlash gear; tappets, pushrods and rockers
valvetrain.note: 'arbre à cames central sous le vilebrequin entraîné par une distribution par pignons, culbuteurs actionnés par tiges, culasses en aluminium ... avec chambres hémisphériques, deux soupapes en tête'; 'synchronisé au vilebrequin par un engrenage avec rattrapage de jeu'. kfz-tech.de: 'The cam shaft was mounted underneath the crankshaft, driving the valves via push rods and rocker arms' (https://www.kfz-tech.de/Engl/Hersteller/Citroen/Citroen2CVM.htm).

intake_type.value: one carburettor in the middle of a common intake tube feeding both heads
intake_type.note: 'the flanges for the common intake tube ... On top of it, in the middle, the carburettor was mounted'. Runner length and bore not found.

cooling.value: forced air from a fan on the crankshaft nose, plus an oil cooler
cooling.note: 'refroidissement ... à air pulsé par une turbine ... placée directement en bout d'arbre moteur'; 'un radiateur d'huile frontal'.

cam_lobe_centre.unit: deg (Citroën's recommended lobe centre for a standard camshaft; which lobe and from which TDC not stated)
cam_lobe_centre.note: 'Citroën recommended 108° for a standard 2CV camshaft (Original camshaft only).' The tool measures the lobe at 0.90 mm below full lift on each side. Not used to place the model's cam, because the lobe it refers to is not stated.

variant.value: type A 79/1, plate AYA 2: Dyane from 1968, 2CV 4 from February 1970 to 1979
variant.note: 'A partir de 1968 apparaît une nouvelle Dyane équipée d'un nouveau moteur de 435 cm3 ... A partir de 1970, ce même moteur équipe la nouvelle 2 CV 4 ... jusqu'à leurs disparitions respectives ... conserve sa puissance de 26 ch SAE.' It derives from the 425 type A 79/0 ('comme le moteur de 425 cm3 Type A 79/0-AYA dont il dérive'), with new heads whose inlet and exhaust faces are no longer aligned and exhaust heat exchangers.

bore_mm.note: '68,5 x 59 mm d'alésage x course'. French Wikipedia agrees (https://fr.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Moteur_bicylindre_boxer_Citro%C3%ABn&oldid=241039053).

compression_ratio.note: Retro-Design table, 2CV4 A79/1 AYA2: '8,5:1'. French Wikipedia: 8,5 (https://fr.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Moteur_bicylindre_boxer_Citro%C3%ABn&oldid=241039053).

cam_timing.note: No valve timing found for this engine.

carburettor.value: Solex 34 PICS (34 PCIS with idle brake), venturi 28 mm, main jet 155
carburettor.note: Factory bulletin table 'VERGASER SOLEX 34 PICS 6 UND 34 PCIS 6', 'Motor A. 79/1': 'Lufttrichter 28', 'Hauptdüse 155'. The 1977 bulletin lists the 2CV 4 with 'SOLEX 34 PICS 10'. French Wikipedia: 'Solex 34 PICS ou PCIS' (https://fr.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Moteur_bicylindre_boxer_Citro%C3%ABn&oldid=241039053).

throttle_dia_mm.note: From the type name; venturi 28 mm.

peak_power_kw.note: 'délivrant 26 ch SAE ou 24 ch din à 6 750 tr/mn'. Retro-Design: '24ch Din à 6750trs/min' (https://www.retro-design.fr/fr/content/11-fiche-technique-2cv4-2cv6). 24 ch = 17.65 kW.

peak_torque_nm.note: Retro-Design: '24ch Din à 6750trs/min – 28Nm à 4000trs/min'. No factory figure found.

idle_rpm.note: A 79/1 with 34 PICS 6: 'Einstellung des Leerlaufs 800 ± 50 U/min'.

exhaust_notes.value: each head pipe runs through a heat exchanger; the two join in a crossbox under the gearbox, then one pipe runs back to a silencer and the outlet
exhaust_notes.note: 'un nouveau type de chauffage où l'air est à la fois réchauffé par le moteur mais aussi, ensuite, par deux gros échangeurs thermiques traversés par les échappements'. The crossbox and rear silencer layout is described for the 602 (https://www.mehariclub.com/en/1009100--under-gearbox-exhaust); vendors list the same parts for the 435 (exhaust kits '435cc' and '602cc', https://www.mehariclub.com/en/2cv/engine/exhaust/?page=1). Lengths not found.

missing: exhaust pipe lengths, crossbox and silencer volumes

sources.what: Méhari Club Cassis (2CV and Méhari parts supplier and engine rebuilder, which runs one of the historic 2CV engine-renovation lines), article 'Evolution : depuis la 2 CV A jusqu'à la 2 CV 6, tous les moteurs bicylindres de 1949 à 1990', 25 May 2020: every engine type with dates, bore and stroke, compression and ratings. Club history, no factory document cited.

French Wikipedia, 'Moteur bicylindre boxer Citroën' (formerly 'Moteur de Citroën 2CV'), revision 241039053: construction (two-bearing built-up crankshaft, gear-driven central camshaft, pushrods, hemispherical heads), wasted-spark ignition, exhaust layouts and a table of every engine type. Its table cites no sources.
Retro-Design, 'Fiche technique 2CV4 - 2CV6': engine table with type codes, plates, compression, DIN power and torque per period. Retailer, not a factory document.

kfz-tech.de, 'Citroën 2 CV (engine)': description of the engine (central camshaft under the crank, pushrods, common intake tube with the carburettor in the middle, needle-bearing rods on a crankshaft supplied complete, large flywheel). Reference site.

Citroën Kundendienst 'Technische Information' bulletins for the A-models (2CV, Dyane, Méhari, Ami), German-language factory service bulletins of the 1970s and 1980s bound in one scan: carburettor types and settings per engine (A 79/1, M 28/1, M 28), idle speeds.
ICE (Belgian 2CV specialist), 'Multi-tool 2CV / Visa' instructions: camshaft timing check, quoting Citroën's recommended lobe centre of 108 degrees for a standard camshaft.
Méhari Club Cassis, inlet valve 435 cc: head 39 mm, stem 8 mm, length 89.5 mm. Vendor.
Méhari Club Cassis, exhaust valve 435 cc or 602 cc: 34 mm. Vendor.
Méhari Club Cassis, under-gearbox exhaust crossbox for the second-generation 602 cc engine: what it joins and where the gases go next. Vendor.
Méhari Club Cassis exhaust parts list: clamp for the secondary exhaust pipe 2CV 01/1950 to 07/1972, 32 mm. Vendor.

curb_kg.note: Factory technical data, 2CV column: 'Leergewicht, fahrbereit ... 535 bis 2/1970 ... 600 ab 2/1970' (kerb weight, ready to drive: 535 kg up to February 1970, 600 kg from February 1970). Not split between 2CV 4 and 2CV 6. citroenet's 1970 entry gives 560 kg (https://www.citroenet.org.uk/passenger-cars/michelin/2cv/history/1970.html).

gears.note: '1 19 : 28 x 14 : 31 x 15 : 32 (6,961) ... 28,715 ... 3,761; 2 ... (3,553) ... 14,659 ... 7,367; 3 15 : 32 (2,133) ... 8,799 ... 12,274; 4 19 : 28 (1,473) ... 6,078 ... 17,769'. The helper who read Citroën's homologation report HOM-A1 of January 1984 (https://a.storyblok.com/f/332646/x/1da256625e/64-citroen-2cv-kundendienst-werkstatt-de-v1.pdf) reported the same 'G1' ratios and 4,125 for the 2CV 4 of 2/1970 to 9/79; I did not read that page myself.

wheel_radius_m.note: Factory gearbox tables: 'Getriebeübersetzung: gültig für Fahrzeuge mit Reifengröße 125 SR 15, dynamischer Abrollumfang 1800 mm' (ratios valid for 125 SR 15 tyres, dynamic rolling circumference 1800 mm). Radius = 1.8 m / 2 pi, my conversion; a published rolling circumference.

tyre.note: From the gearbox-table header (see wheel_radius_m). Front-wheel drive.

top_speed_kmh.note: 1970 2CV 4 column: 'Maximum speed 102 kph'. French Wikipedia's model table also gives 102 km/h (https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Citro%C3%ABn_2_CV).

driven.note: English Wikipedia, 'Citroën 2CV' (read 2026-11-17), infobox layout: Front-engine, front-wheel-drive (also a dual-engine four-wheel-drive version).

sources.what: Citroën Reparaturhandbuch Nr. 854 Band 1, January 1983, 'A-Modelle ab 1963' (German factory workshop manual, scan distributed by Der Franzose GmbH): kerb weights, gearbox tables (section A.330-00) with gearbox, final-drive and overall ratios and km/h per 1000 rpm on 125 SR 15 tyres of 1800 mm rolling circumference.
Citroën Kundendienst bulletin compilation (German), including homologation report HOM-A1 of January 1984 with gearbox table 1.3. Read by a helper, not by me.
Citroënët 2CV 1970 page: 2CV 4 and 2CV 6 engines and maximum speeds.
